title: Complete saved ContextPack read v1
description: Complete success envelope for an explicit saved-pack or latest read. The root accepts json and rendered responses; select a format-specific anchor when the original query format is known.
$comment: Source artifact only; no validator, generator or runtime verification was executed. Register this whole local resource before resolving anchors. The ID is an identifier, not a hosted endpoint. Retain parseContextPackReadQuery/Envelope, canonical contextPackReadHashJson and SHA-256 verification, request matching and Gateway authority/source checks. This schema does not describe compilation commands, old sections-based entities, MCP outer wrappers, HTTP headers or Mock configuration.

ulid.$comment: Matches the existing isUlid character/length contract; does not introduce a new first-character restriction.

savedName.$comment: Used for saved pack/item traces and selected/excluded item IDs. The current shared parser requires nonblank UTF-16 length <=4096; it does not apply the outer request-trace control-character restriction to these fields.

requestTrace.$comment: Runtime isSyncIdentifier additionally rejects unpaired surrogates and counts UTF-16 units; this trace must equal the original read trace.

clientConstraint.$comment: CLI parseSyncCommandIdentity text constraint; runtime also rejects unpaired surrogates and checks equality with the authenticated client. This is not a credential.

timestamp.$comment: Runtime requires valid exact UTC millisecond round-trip, receipt.created_at < pack.expires_at and every supplied item expiry >= pack expiry. Format may be annotation-only.

ContextPackReadQuery.title: Saved-pack read query
ContextPackReadQuery.$comment: Input is limited to 4096 bytes at runtime. Omitted pack_id selects latest; empty/null IDs are invalid. Omitted format normalizes to json; default is an annotation and does not mutate input. SDK/MCP use this object; public HTTP uses URL query parameters and no GET body.

ContextPackReadNormalizedQuery.$comment: The shared query parser returns format explicitly; the success envelope does not echo this query.

ContextPackReadCliQuery.title: CLI context get JSON input
ContextPackReadCliQuery.$comment: Both identity constraints may be omitted; if supplied, both are required. Total CLI JSON input is limited to 4096 bytes. --timeout-ms is a CLI option, not a JSON field. Scope/credentials remain external; this four-field object must not be sent as the public GET body or MCP arguments.

ContextPackReadSourceRef.$comment: Matches validateSourceRef through the complete read parser: nonempty strings, optional nonnegative safe revision. No invented text maximum, whitespace restriction or URI format/access guarantee. Source lists remain bounded by total response bytes/JSON complexity.

ContextPackReadItem.title: Complete selected saved item
ContextPackReadItem.$comment: Full content, including empty strings, is retained. Item scope must equal pack scope and the original read scope. Item IDs must be unique across selected and excluded arrays. Optional revision/expiry are omitted, never null. Runtime rejects nonfinite numbers and verifies expiry ordering. Saved confirmed/sensitivity fields are not present authorization.

SavedContextPack.title: Complete persisted ContextPack document
SavedContextPack.$comment: pack_version is the document format version, not receipt.version. Runtime requires items.length + exclusions.length <=1000 and distinct IDs across both arrays. source_refs is exactly the ordered first-occurrence union of complete selected source objects; repeated per-item sources are allowed. Hash must be recomputed from canonical complete content, excluding only this pack's top-level trace_id and pack_hash. This object is not the legacy sections-based ContextPack entity.

ContextPackReadRendered.title: Complete markdown representation
ContextPackReadRendered.$comment: Both markdown and mcp formats use this shape. Runtime requires the exact encoded project/saved pack URI and rendered text reconstructed from every selected item and source, not just a plausible URI/text. Empty packs render as empty text. This is not the outer MCP resource contents wrapper.

ContextPackReadReceipt.$comment: used_tokens must equal sum(max(1,ceil(item.content.length/4))) using JavaScript UTF-16 lengths, and must not exceed pack.budget_tokens. created_at must precede pack expiry. Explicit query pack_id must match; latest selection is enforced by the producer, not by this shape. The enclosing request format determines whether rendered must be absent or present.

ContextPackReadEnvelope.title: Complete saved pack success envelope

etag.$comment: Runtime requires buildEtag(data.version) exactly, including safe integer range; a matching pattern alone does not bind the version.

ContextPackReadEnvelope.$comment: Complete success is limited to 2 MiB, including rendered. Runtime requires original trace/scope/selected ID/format, revision=data.version, canonical JSON ETag and source_refs exactly [{type:'context-pack',id:data.pack_id},...data.pack.source_refs]. The root accepts either format shape; use a specialized anchor or pass the original query to the shared parser. Metadata and a valid hash shape do not prove saved content integrity, current source validity or read permission.

ContextPackReadJsonEnvelope.$comment: Use for format=json, including omitted format. Even rendered=null is forbidden.

ContextPackReadRenderedEnvelope.$comment: Use for format=markdown or mcp. Content remains a complete pack, with a complete rendered representation.
